newsitem.title: USA: American General sees Q2 gain from loan sale.
newsitem.headline: American General sees Q2 gain from loan sale.

text.p: American General Corp said Wednesday it expected to report "a small gain" from the sale of $253 million in home satellite dish loans to Associates First Capital Inc.
The company said its consumer finance unit, American General Finance, signed a definitive agreement with Associates First for the sale of the loan portfolio.
The portfolio includes revolving-credit home improvement loans as well as the satellite dish loans, the company said.
The sale is part of American General's previously announced decision to shed its satellite dish loans and other bank credit card loans.
The company said it is in negotiations with another party for the sale of the bank credit card loans.
